message:
1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:45: interpolation reads `label` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence an inline outlet's context hands a listbox's row, whose variables its element reads (`[attr.aria-posinset]="i + 1"`, `[attr.data-pct-part]="part"`, `[id]="'pct-widget-row-' + label"`). A variable takes the entry of the context's map under its key, `let-label` the implicit one and not `part: 'option'`; and it stands for no template — the outlet names the template beside the context, and a variable standing for it made the row's element one more node handing the template, its `id` one more refusal.
